meta.title: Palette
meta.description: Less is Great. LiG highlights code with a few colors.

hero.lede: Syntax highlighting uses a few colors. The rest of the palette stays out of the code.

palette.variantHint: Site chrome stays paper; previews below use the selected LiG variant.

preview.paperLede: 占位：LiG semantic colors on a mini card.

downloads.nvimNote: Neovim theme distribution; editor packages are released separately.
downloads.vscodeNote: VS Code theme distribution; editor packages are released separately.
downloads.tokens: Generated token files in this repo
downloads.lightweightNote: Four variants from the same tokens. Downloads follow the selected theme.

syntax.lede: Mono is the reading baseline. Struct marks bindings and structure, ref marks values and references, and action marks execution.
syntax.aside: Highlight / base / muted set the reading hierarchy. Mono selects steps from the neutral ramp; colored families use OKLCH offsets. Contrast readings guide the balance, rather than set a hard limit.

families.struct: Parameter bindings, modules, tags and modifiers
families.ref: Type references, constants, values and escapes
families.action: Functions, constructors, calls, async and exceptions

palette.paletteNote: The full source palette. Open it for a hex. Reading code does not need it.

oklch.title: Where the colors sit
oklch.note: Design coordinates in OKLCH. Display colors are mapped to sRGB.
oklch.hueChroma: Hue and chroma of the eight base colors

lab.title: Five ways to choose
lab.lede: Each control drives the same demo. One of them goes on the home page.

stop.name: Stop
stop.note: The site's full stop marks the choice and travels to it.

sentence.name: Sentence
sentence.note: Four variants combine two tones with neutral or paper treatments.

wildmenu.name: Wildmenu
wildmenu.note: It is a Neovim theme. Choose it the way Neovim does, inside the editor.

circle.name: Circle
circle.note: The pen circles the choice, the way it circles a price.

matrix.name: Matrix
matrix.note: Tone by edge. The grid shows where each variant sits.

inspect.title: Node inspector
inspect.help: Hover to inspect · click to pin · keyboard: ← → tokens, ↑ parent, ↓ child, Esc clear
inspect.fallback: No color capture; uses the primary foreground.
inspect.empty: Hover any part of the code, or choose a node below.
inspect.provenance: Parsed by Neovim {version}. Positions are 1-based byte columns; end is exclusive. Tree-sitter only; no LSP.

terminal.title: Terminal 16 colors
terminal.note: Resolved port values for the selected theme. SGR lists foreground / background codes. Text contrast is measured against terminal.background:
terminal.contrastNote: APCA is an experimental contrast model, not a finalized WCAG 3 requirement. Emphasis follows the theme: lighter in dark mode, darker in light mode.
terminal.slotNote: Black and white are ANSI slot names; in a light theme they can map to light and dark neutrals. Default foreground/background are separate settings.
